headline: India Identifies Tara Gas; UKMTO Report Leaves Vessels Unnamed
deck: Oman says its navy and coastguard joined the evacuation after a fire off Musandam.
body: India has identified the Panama-flagged LPG tanker attacked in the Strait of Hormuz on 16 November as MT Tara Gas. It said 21 of the 24 Indian nationals aboard were safely evacuated, two injured crew members were admitted to hospital and one Indian national remained missing. [E1] UKMTO had not identified the vessels involved in reported attacks or attributed responsibility. [E6]

India’s embassy in Oman was monitoring the search and rescue operation with Omani authorities. [E7] The Ministry of External Affairs said commercial shipping and civilian infrastructure must not be targeted and called for an immediate end to such attacks. [E8] Oman’s Maritime Security Centre identified the vessel as Tara Gas and said the fire was about two nautical miles off Musandam governorate. [E4] It said the evacuation was carried out with the Royal Navy of Oman and the Coast Guard Police of the Royal Oman Police. [E5]

gCaptain reported that the repeated attack forced the 25-member crew to abandon the vessel. [E2] The full extent of damage to Tara Gas and any potential environmental impact remain unknown. Responsibility for the attacks has not been independently established. [E3]
